identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: The email, phone, profile URL, or domain that was searched.

identifierField.title: Identifier field
identifierField.description: Which query field was sent: email, phone, profile_url, or domain.

ok.title: Request succeeded
ok.description: True when Expose accepted the search.

found.title: Report has data
found.description: True when the report object is not empty.

statusCode.title: HTTP status
statusCode.description: Status code from Expose. 0 means the request did not complete.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why this row failed. Empty when the request succeeded.

creditsCharged.title: Credits charged
creditsCharged.description: 1 when Expose charged a credit for this row, otherwise 0.

report.title: Report
report.description: The data object returned by GET /api/search.
